stories.title: Iowa Democrat elected to statehouse despite dropping out of race beforehand has resigned from seat
stories.summary: Eric Armstrong won Iowa House District 20 with 55.15% of the vote.

stories.title: Army deems lead azide detonation a success but criticism lingers over notification
stories.summary: Environmentalists and some elected leaders say officials should have shared more information sooner, particularly with other communities in the path of the plume.

stories.title: Gov. Reynolds sets date for Iowa Senate District 11 special election
stories.summary: The seat, which includes Marion and Warren Counties, has been vacant since June 8, when Sen. Julian Garrett died.

stories.title: West Des Moines firefighters celebrate Thanksgiving on duty with family and new traditions
stories.summary: Firefighter Max McCay spent his first Thanksgiving on duty in West Des Moines, helping turn the station into a festive gathering place with family and colleagues.

stories.title: The lead azide detonation happened. Now the real work begins to study it
stories.summary: After detonating five tons of a toxic chemical in Iowa, the EPA found no airborne lead, but experts caution that soil and water tests could reveal long-term risks.

stories.title: 'Same name, same team, same week': RAGBRAI announces ownership change, start of new era
stories.summary: RAGBRAI, the iconic ride across Iowa, will transition to new ownership ahead of next summer's ride, promising a new chapter for the Hawkeye State staple.

stories.title: Iowa's wild trout populations thrive as DNR prepares for winter spawning season
stories.summary: The DNR will collect 750,000 rainbow trout eggs this season and continues efforts to restore native brook trout. But today, every brown trout in Iowa is wild-raised.

stories.title: 1 dead after crash in Boone County, roadway closed for nearly 10 hours
stories.summary: A semi truck hit a passenger vehicle entering an intersection, and then a second semi truck crashed into the vehicle, the Boone County Sheriff's Office said.

stories.title: What to watch today: 24/7 livestreaming on WeAreIowa
stories.summary: WeAreIowa offers 24/7 news streaming on your favorite Roku, Apple TV and Amazon Fire TV device, as well as on-demand news, weather and sports content.

stories.title: 'Far exceeded expectations' | State, federal leaders react to lead azide detonation
stories.summary: Officials are calling the lead azide detonation in Middletown Wednesday morning a success, though Iowa's governor-elect urged immediate transparency.

stories.title: Army detonates nation's stockpile of lead azide in Iowa
stories.summary: After several delays, the U.S. Army has detonated a stockpile of lead azide that officials say is unsafe to move due to the risk of spontaneous explosion.

stories.title: Des Moines organizations prepare Thanksgiving meals for thousands in community
stories.summary: Two organizations are preparing to serve thousands of free Thanksgiving dinners for families across the Des Moines area.
